title: Dongshan Liangjie
speaker: Junka Ken Oates
summary: The talk highlights the importance of direct experience and the distinction between relative and ultimate truth, as emphasized by Dongshan Liangzhe, the founder of Japanese Sodo Zen. Dongshan's teachings, such as the "instant moment of realization," encourage practitioners to look beyond words and conceptual understanding, instead embracing the present moment and letting go of attachments and ego. By doing so, practitioners can tap into the ultimate truth of reality, free from the limitations of the relative world.
topics: Song of the Jewel Mirror Samadhi
